items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: I'm going to play you something you'd probably like to hear one of Chopin's, La Baroque Polonaise.

ctx.x: Briggs and he had an orchestra --." The person said, "Why sure, Arthur, I know him well, I've been a patron in the place, I can contact him and find out.--," you know. Then Louis told him about how we met way back and worked together and everything else. Then we made a contact and he asked me out to his home, and he lived in very, very fine suburbs of Paris, at Pol Le Deux (??). That's near Versailles. Beaugerval, Beau Crescent, near Versailles. And he invited us to his home and I took my wife and my daughter…
